title: Wave Echo Cave · Area 9 · Great cavern

sourceRecords.title: Area 9 · Great cavern
read: The hall opens around long stone tables and cold braziers. Stairs climb to ledges at either end, above a floor scattered with the remains of an ancient battle.

Cold braziers offer no warmth to the long tables. The stairs and ledges at either end rise above the scattered remains, giving the chamber more than one level to watch. Anything moving across the open floor would be difficult to overlook from above.

brief: Great cavern, HIGH LEDGES at east and west and LOWER middle, ten-foot escarpments with carved stairs. TWO large ancient tables and TWO cold braziers in middle, smaller table on eastern ledge. Dozens of old dwarf, gnome, orc and ogre bones scattered. Seven ghouls on WEST ledge stay concealed in shadow. Off-frame visitor lantern, no permanent light or living battle.
